data.summary: Beispielstrom Mittelhessen GmbH is raising the prices in Bastian Musterquell's "Region Basis" electricity tariff from 1 January 2027, citing higher grid-usage and procurement costs: the monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises from €86.00 to €92.00.
data.explanation: Your electricity supplier is increasing the per-kWh price, the base fee and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) starting 1 January 2027. Because this is a price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract without notice for that date instead of accepting the new price — the app will show you the exact deadline by which your cancellation must reach the supplier in writing (Textform). If you do nothing, the new prices simply take effect.
